label: John D. Podesta
narrative: Podesta is the only person to have held senior White House staff positions in two administrations and to have publicly and repeatedly demanded UFO declassification. He was Staff Secretary during the years the Rockefeller Initiative was working the Clinton White House and Chief of Staff when the administration ended without acting on it. On 22 October 2002, out of office, he appeared at a National Press Club event for the Coalition for Freedom of Information and called for the government to declassify its UFO records, framing it in the language of open government rather than belief - 'It's time to find out what the truth really is that's out there.' He returned to the White House as Counselor to President Obama in 2014 and, on leaving in February 2015, wrote publicly that his biggest failure of that year was 'once again not securing the disclosure of the UFO files.' Podesta's arc is the cleanest available demonstration that proximity to the presidency is not proximity to the compartments: a man who ran the White House twice could not get the files, and said so out loud. The Clinton Library's own UFO FOIA collections - Greer/CSETI correspondence (2006-0474-F), the Roswell file (2006-0476-F), the Firmage email file (2008-0359-F) - show what did reach the building: petitions and press, not programme records.

timeline.label: Podesta calls for declassification
timeline.text: Six days after the Wilson meeting, the former White House Chief of Staff appears at the National Press Club for the Coalition for Freedom of Information and demands the government open its UFO files.

unexplainedResidual: Two terms as a senior White House official produced no access to programme records. Either the records do not exist or they sit outside the chain a Chief of Staff can reach.
